label: Claude Opus 5.5 (LLM, zero-shot)
selection: stratified by bird count (1-5 x4, 6-15 x3, 16-40 x2, 41-100 x1), one sub-dataset per crop where possible, seed 42; crops with birds only

protocol.how: Detections produced by Claude Opus 5.5 inside an interactive Claude Code session (no API call; no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on this machine), crop by crop, before the ground truth was read.
protocol.inputs: Each 512x512 crop shown upscaled 2x, plain and with a coordinate grid labelled in crop pixels (llm_inputs/). Where birds were tiny or clustered, 4x zooms of sub-regions with an 8-px grid were also viewed (crops 2, 6, 7, 8 and all four quadrants of crop 9). Views were shown as PNG; llm_inputs/ stores them as JPEG q95.
protocol.prompt: Find every bird; give its box in crop pixels and a confidence.
protocol.scores: Three levels, not a calibrated probability: 0.9 clearly a bird, 0.6 likely, 0.3 possible.
protocol.boxes: Read off the grid by eye. In the densest crop (J_..._0443) every bird was marked as a fixed 12x12 box around its centre.
